title: Ox Passion Mint Mix Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Salts Mint Mix is a refreshing fusion of ice-cool mint varieties, expertly blended for a layered and uplifting vape. A bright peppermint top note gives way to the cooling depth of spearmint, finishing with a clean and frosty exhale. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG balance, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, delivering smooth nicotine satisfaction with a refined flavour profile. Ideal for use with pod vape kits and starter devices, it provides a consistently fresh and satisfying vape experience. Developed by Oxva, a trusted name in vaping technology, the OX Passion Salts range brings expertly crafted flavours designed to pair seamlessly with Oxva’s XLIM pod kits and other refillable vape devices.
